class.name: FlowNode
class.brief_description: Base class of all node types of a [FlowGraph].

method.name: _choose_exit
method.description: Returns the flow output to leave through after [method _enter] returned [constant FlowGraphPlayback.ENTER_RESULT_CONTINUE], or when [method FlowGraphPlayback.advance] continues a waiting node. The default is the first flow output. An output without a connection ends the graph.

method.name: _enter
method.description: Called when the node becomes the current node. Do the work of the node here and return whether the playback continues, waits or ends the graph. The default continues.

method.name: _evaluate_output
method.description: Returns the value of the data output [param port]. Called when a connected input of another node is read; read your own inputs with [method FlowGraphPlayback.get_input_value]. The default is the port's default value.

method.name: _exit
method.description: Called when the playback leaves the node.

method.name: _get_available_exits
method.description: Returns the ways to leave the node, for [method FlowGraphPlayback.get_available_exits] and [method FlowGraphPlayback.choose]. The default is one [FlowExit] per flow output, labeled with the port label or name. Leave [member FlowExit.node_id] at [code]-1[/code]; the playback fills it.

method.name: _get_category
method.description: Override to return the category of the node, used to group node types in the node menu of the graph editor, for example [code]Flow[/code] or [code]Inventory[/code]. The built-in node types use [code]Flow[/code], [code]Data[/code], [code]Variables[/code] and [code]Events[/code]. If not overridden, the category of a built-in node type is used, and an empty string for a script node type.

method.name: _get_configuration_warnings
method.description: Override to return warnings about the configuration of the node, for example a missing property. Each string is one warning. The warnings are added to those of a built-in node type, and [method FlowGraph.validate] reports every warning as [constant FlowGraphValidation.ISSUE_KIND_NODE_WARNING]. Return an empty array if the node is fine.

method.name: _get_inline_properties
method.description: Override to return the names of the properties that the graph editor shows inside the node, so the user does not need to select it. If overridden, the result replaces the inline properties of a built-in node type.

method.name: _get_input_ports
method.description: Override to return the input ports of the node. The result is cached until [method notify_ports_changed] is called. Entries that are [code]null[/code] are ignored, and port names must be unique. If not overridden, the input ports of a built-in node type are used, and a script node type has none.

method.name: _get_output_ports
method.description: Override to return the output ports of the node. The result is cached until [method notify_ports_changed] is called. Entries that are [code]null[/code] are ignored, and port names must be unique. If not overridden, the output ports of a built-in node type are used, and a script node type has none.

method.name: _get_title
method.description: Override to return the title of the node. [member title_override] takes precedence. If the result is empty or the method is not overridden, the title is the name of the script class ([code]class_name[/code]) or of the native class, without the [code]Flow[/code] prefix and the [code skip-lint]Node[/code] suffix, in words (for example [code]GetVariableNode[/code] becomes [code]Get Variable[/code]).

method.name: _get_translatable_strings
method.description: Override to return the texts of the node that should be translated, for example a dialogue line. Each entry is one string, described as a [PackedStringArray] in the order of the translation extractor: message id, context, plural id, comment (trailing items may be left out). [method FlowGraph.get_translatable_strings] collects the entries of all nodes of a graph. Return an empty array if the node has no texts.

method.name: _process_waiting
method.description: Called by [method FlowGraphPlayback.process] while the node waits ([constant FlowGraphPlayback.ENTER_RESULT_WAIT]). Return [code]true[/code] to continue through [method _choose_exit]. Implementing it turns processing of [FlowGraphPlayer] on while the node waits; nodes that wait for the game (a button, a signal) do not implement it and cost nothing per frame.

method.name: find_input_port
method.description: Returns the input port named [param name], or [code]null[/code] if there is none.

method.name: find_output_port
method.description: Returns the output port named [param name], or [code]null[/code] if there is none.

method.name: get_category
method.description: Returns the category of the node, see [method _get_category].

method.name: get_configuration_warnings
method.description: Returns the warnings of the node: those of the built-in node type, followed by those of [method _get_configuration_warnings]. An empty array means the node is fine.

method.name: get_inline_properties
method.description: Returns the names of the properties shown inside the node, see [method _get_inline_properties].

method.name: get_input_ports
method.description: Returns the input ports of the node, see [method _get_input_ports]. The array is a copy; the [FlowPort] objects are shared with the node, so do not change them.

method.name: get_output_ports
method.description: Returns the output ports of the node, see [method _get_output_ports]. The array is a copy; the [FlowPort] objects are shared with the node, so do not change them.

method.name: get_title
method.description: Returns the title of the node: [member title_override] if it is set, otherwise the result of [method _get_title], otherwise the name of the class (see [method _get_title]).

method.name: get_translatable_strings
method.description: Returns the translatable strings of the node, see [method _get_translatable_strings].

method.name: notify_ports_changed
method.description: Tells the node that its ports changed, so the next call of [method get_input_ports], [method get_output_ports], [method find_input_port] or [method find_output_port] asks for them again. Also emits [signal Resource.changed]. Built-in node types call it when a property that changes their ports is set. Call it from your own setters when the ports depend on a property. Connections that use a port that no longer exists are not removed; [method FlowGraph.validate] reports them.

members.member: A free comment of the author that the graph editor shows with the node. It has no effect on the graph.
The position of the node in the graph editor, in pixels. [method FlowGraph.add_node] sets it from its [code]position[/code] argument.
The size of the node in the graph editor, in pixels. [code]Vector2(0, 0)[/code] means the editor picks the size.
If not empty, this text is the title of the node instead of the one from [method _get_title].
